systemfields.description: Nail polish instances with color from attribute for individual parts and different material per part. Set up in Solaris. Also show case of simple modeling techniques.

tags.script_action_help:
Select a primitive in the Scene Viewer or Scene Graph Tree pane.
Ctrl-click to select using the primitive picker dialog.

default_value.expression:
n = hou.pwd()
n_hasFlag = n.isMaterialFlagSet()
i = n.evalParm('inherit_ctrl')
r = 'none'
if i == 1 or (n_hasFlag and i == 2):
    r = 'inherit'
return r
